n_auto_vts.description: Number of virtual terminals (VTs) to manage automatically

reserve_vts.description: List of VT numbers to reserve and not manage (e.g., [1] to reserve the first VT)

kill_user_processes.description: Whether to kill user processes when they log out. Accepts: yes, no, on-last-log

kill_only_users.description: List of users whose processes will be killed on logout (if KillUserProcesses=yes)

kill_exclude_users.description: List of users whose processes will be excluded from killing on logout

handle_lid_switch.description: Action to take when laptop lid is closed. Accepts: ignore, poweroff, reboot, halt, kexec, suspend, hibernate, hybrid-sleep, suspend-hybrid, shutdown

handle_lid_switch_docked.description: Action to take when lid is closed while docked/externally powered (overrides HandleLidSwitch)

handle_power_key.description: Action to take when power button is pressed. Accepts: ignore, poweroff, reboot, halt, kexec, suspend, hibernate, hybrid-sleep, suspend-hybrid, shutdown

handle_suspend_key.description: Action to take when suspend button is pressed

handle_hibernate_key.description: Action to take when hibernate button is pressed

remove_ipc.description: Whether to remove user IPC objects (shared memory, etc.) on logout. Accepts: yes, no, on-last-log

user_tasks_max.description: Maximum number of tasks (threads/processes) allowed per user (0 = system default)

session_tasks_max.description: Maximum number of tasks allowed per user session (0 = system default)

user_inotify_max.description: Maximum number of inotify watches per user (0 = system default)

user_audit_msg_max.description: Maximum number of audit messages per user (0 = system default)

user_seccomp_filter_max.description: Maximum number of seccomp actions per user (0 = system default)

linger.description: Whether to enable linger mode (allow user services to run after logout). Accepts: yes, no

linger_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) before auto-disabling linger (0 = no timeout)

runtime_directory_size.description: Size limit (in bytes) for user runtime directories (e.g., /run/user/UID). 0 = system default

runtime_directory_inodes_max.description: Maximum number of inodes allowed in user runtime directories

cache_directory_size.description: Size limit (in bytes) for user cache directories (0 = system default)

cache_directory_inodes_max.description: Maximum number of inodes allowed in user cache directories

runtime_directory_mode.description: Permissions mode (octal) for user runtime directories

cache_directory_mode.description: Permissions mode (octal) for user cache directories

config_directory_mode.description: Permissions mode (octal) for user config directories

idle_action.description: Action to take when user session is idle. Accepts: none, poweroff, reboot, halt, kexec, suspend, hibernate, hybrid-sleep, suspend-hybrid, shutdown

idle_action_sec.description: Number of seconds of inactivity before triggering IdleAction

wall_message.description: Whether to send wall messages when a user logs in or out

enable_session_tracking.description: Whether to enable session tracking (required for most logind features)

user_switching.description: Whether to allow users to switch between sessions

automatic_login.description: Whether to enable automatic login on seat activation

automatic_login_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for automatic login (0 = no timeout)

remote.description: Whether to allow remote logins (e.g., SSH)

local.description: Whether to allow local logins (e.g., console)

vt_switch.description: Whether to allow switching between VTs (e.g., Ctrl+Alt+F1)

vt_activate.description: Whether to activate sessions automatically on VT switch
